subject: Mythology
title: Dharma: Sacred Duty and Cosmic Law
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Dharma: Sacred Duty and Cosmic Law.

hook.text: Dharma is the force that holds the universe together — the right way to live, act, and fulfill your purpose.

buildup.text: Every person has a unique dharma based on their stage of life, role in society, and spiritual development.

discovery.text: In the Ramayana, Rama endures exile and war not for glory but because dharma demanded he fulfill his duty.

twist.text: Dharma sometimes conflicts with personal desire. The greatest heroes are those who choose duty over happiness.

climax.text: The entire Mahabharata war happened because dharma was violated, showing that ignoring it destroys everything.

punchline.text: The universe runs on duty, and breaking it breaks the world.

quiz.question: What is dharma in Hindu mythology?
options: A meditation technique for achieving inner peace
The sacred duty and cosmic law that holds the universe together
A weapon wielded by the god Vishnu
